Name: Kisekae Skirts for 1.6 with Wildflour Tailoring and Buffs
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
A port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54051772]KabigonFirst's[/url] Kisekae skirts to Content Patcher for SDV 1.6. Being a huge fan of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62367916]Solariaze's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18136]Kisekae Tailoring Recipes[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour's mods[/url], items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Wildflour's Rose and Alchemist mod[/url]﻿ have been used to craft the skirts. When [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/190812873]Mouahrara[/url]'s [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/aedenthorn/blob/master/BuffFramework/release-notes.md]version of Buff Framework[/url] is [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/aedenthorn/releases/download/main-files/BuffFramework-0.6.1-unofficial.9-mouahrara.zip]installed[/url], a small +20 Max Stamina buff is given to the player when a Kisekae skirt is worn. This mod is intended to be used with typical game progression and in-game crafting. 

[b]Recipe List:[/b] cloth +
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]rosefinch feather = peplum skirt
[*]arctic fox = ruffled skirt
[*]pixie's breath = schoolgirl skirt
[*]smile of shumus = bubble skirt
[*]avalune = circle skirt
[*]crow feather = pencil skirt
[*]unicorn horn = princess skirt
[*]phoenix fire = plaid skirt
[*]lovebird feather = flared skirt
[*]dream spinner = bohemian skirt
[*]sylvan sigh = gored skirt
[*]ambrosia = pant skirt (skort)
[/list] [/spoiler]

If you love to use Fashion Sense clothes with Buff Framework installed, the skirt buff will still apply if the Kisekae skirt is worn in the vanilla pants slot. The FS pants/skirt will still be visible.

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
Make sure any dependencies are installed first.
Extract and move the entire folder into your Mods folder.

This is my first uploaded mod for SDV. I have enjoyed countless mods from amazing people! I wanted to start giving something back.  I hope you enjoy!

[b]Credits: [/b] A huge thanks to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62367916]Solariaze[/url] for inspiring me with your initial tailoring recipes and names for the Kisekae skirts. Thank you,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflour[/url] for letting me use your items for the tailoring recipes in my mod; I love your work!  Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/190812873]Mouahrara[/url] for updating aedenthorn's Buff Framework to 1.6. Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]Aedenthorn[/url] for the initial Buff Framework mod. A final thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54051772]KabigonFirst[/url] for creating the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2348]Kisekae skirts[/url] themselves; none of this would be possible otherwise!
